verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents Resolve, a built-in AI agent that takes a production error, writes a tested fix and opens a pull request for review. That is a delegated task handled inside the product. The scope is narrow: the evidence covers only error-to-PR fixing, through brief first-party statements. missing for 10: evidence of broader task delegation beyond error fixes, in-depth docs on how tasks are assigned and controlled, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Resolve is an AI agent in Rollbar that takes a production error and produces a pull request you can review.
Resolve writes a tested fix and opens the pull request for you to approve.
